name: Water injection manifold and W.I. pig launcher/receiver
description: The West Desaru WSS houses water injection flowlines, manifolds and a pig launcher, with produced oil routed to the FP5 MOPU and exported through a 14-km subsea pipeline to an FSO via an 8-in flexible riser.
aliases: Water injection manifold and W.I. pig launcher/receiver

specifications.basis: West Desaru WSS topsides accommodate oil production, gas lift and water injection flowlines plus manifolds

specifications.basis: West Desaru WSS houses a pig launcher and an 8-in (20-cm) flexible riser

specifications.metric: Pig launcher and flexible riser — subsea export pipeline length
specifications.basis: Produced oil processed at MOPU then returned to WSS for export via 14-km (8.7-mi) subsea pipeline to an FSO
